context: Ren interviews a researcher about long hours.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic interview; vocabulary (働い/無視/かける/学会/超える) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 研究に、長く働いていらっしゃいますね。
lines.en: You've worked long on your research.
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 気づけば、十年を超えて働いています。
lines.en: Before I knew it, I've worked over ten years.
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 学会では、発表もされますか?
lines.en: Do you present at conferences too?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 毎年、学会に時間をかけています。
lines.en: Each year, I devote time to the conference.
lines.style: patient researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 批判を、無視することもありますか?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 批判は、無視せず受け止めます。
lines.en: I don't ignore criticism; I take it in.
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 限界を超える瞬間も、ありますか?
lines.en: Are there moments you surpass your limits?
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 想像を超える発見に、時間をかけます。
lines.en: I devote time to discoveries beyond imagination.
lines.style: warm researcher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
